steps.title: What is a discovered attack?
steps.body: A discovered attack happens when moving one piece uncovers an attack by another piece behind it.

steps.title: The uncovered rook
steps.body: The knight on e4 blocks the rook on e1 from the king on e8. When the knight moves, the rook gives check.

steps.title: Your move
steps.body: Move the knight anywhere to uncover the rook's check.
steps.hint: Any knight move from e4 uncovers the rook. Choose one that also attacks something.
steps.success: Check! A knight move that also gives check is very strong.
